description: One slot in a wireframe archetype: which region it belongs to, which component type fills it, and where it sits. Width and height are left unset — the operation engine resolves them from the active WireframeSchemaRegistry.

members.name: Region
members.description: Named region of the archetype, e.g. "navbar" or "hero".

members.name: Type
members.description: Component type that fills the slot, e.g. "TmMenu".

members.name: WSpan
members.description: Optional column span; null lets the engine decide.
